talentTitle: Striker who plays barefoot and never loses the ball
story: Musa organises a match on the red-dirt pitch every evening after school. Coaches from two districts already know his name.

talentTitle: A voice that silences the whole compound
story: Aminata leads the singing at every community gathering. She writes her own verses about school and home.

talentTitle: Top of her class — teaches younger children to read
story: Hawa runs a small reading circle under the mango tree. Her dream is to become a teacher in her own town.

talentTitle: Wants to be the doctor his village never had
story: Ibrahim helps at the community health post, carrying water and keeping records. He knows every family on his street.

talentTitle: The smallest dancer with the biggest presence
story: Kadiatu learned every traditional step by watching the elders. Now the elders watch her.

talentTitle: Draws the whole neighbourhood from memory
story: Fatmata sketches with charcoal on cardboard. Her portraits of market women stop people in the street.

talentTitle: THIS ENTRY NEVER RENDERS — guardian consent not on file
story: Demonstrates the safeguarding render rule: without both consent flags set to true, a child cannot appear anywhere on the site.

talentTitle: THIS ENTRY NEVER RENDERS — removed flag set
story: Flip "removed": true on any child and they disappear from the whole site within one deploy.
